summary: Eldorado Gold filed a Form 6-K reporting Q1 2026 results and disclosed that CEO George Burns will retire in Q3 2026 upon Skouries ramp-up, with President Christian Milau succeeding him. No financial terms are associated with the change; it is an orderly succession. The board appointment of Sally Eyre was also noted but is routine. The filing is a foreign private issuer report; the CEO retirement is a planned transition, not forced, but classified here as a management change since it is a voluntary departure with a clear timeline. Watch for any subsequent accelerated departure or strategic shift post-transition.
